ANURAG VASI
Senior React Native & React.js Engineer | Mobile & Frontend Architecture | 10+ Years
+91-8125237003  |  vasi.anurag@gmail.com  |  linkedin.com/in/anurag-vasi-46595810a  |  Hyderabad, India
Remote (worldwide) or hybrid in Hyderabad  |  4+ hrs daily overlap with US Eastern; full overlap with UK, EU, Middle East & APAC
SUMMARY
Senior mobile and frontend engineer with 10+ years shipping React Native and React.js products end-to-end, with 7 apps released to the App 
Store and Google Play. Sole developer on multiple production client codebases, including a white-label React Native platform serving 4 client 
brands and an enterprise Next.js account. Built the frontend of an internal LLM/RAG document platform on Pinecone vector search. Track 
record of picking up unfamiliar stacks fast — moved from .NET to React, web to React Native, and learned Vue.js in a week to deliver a client 
prototype. Also lead teams, but happiest with significant hands-on ownership.
TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS
• Shipped 7 mobile apps to the App Store and Google Play, owning the process end-to-end from architecture through release across both 
iOS and Android workflows
• Architected a white-label React Native codebase producing 4 independently branded client apps, with full Bitrise CI/CD for per-brand 
builds, code signing, and store releases
• Built the conversational frontend for an LLM/RAG document platform using Pinecone vector search and multi-workspace document 
isolation
• Eliminated performance bottlenecks on a production banking app through dependency auditing, app/bundle size reduction, 
memoization, and list virtualization
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Engineer / Tech Lead — React Native & React.js Jun 2022 – Present
Omnics Technologies (product & services) — Hyderabad, India
• Sole developer on the Konica Minolta account, building Next.js pages with SSG and ISR to improve SEO, Core Web Vitals, and load 
performance
• Architected and solo-developed a white-label React Native codebase serving 4 separate client brands, including the full Bitrise CI/CD 
pipeline supporting a monthly release cadence across all brands, with code signing and submission via App Store Connect, TestFlight, and 
Google Play Console
• Built the conversational frontend for DMS, an internal LLM-powered document platform where uploads are embedded into Pinecone 
vector storage and queried in natural language across isolated workspaces; also owned requirements and led the project
• Built a content management platform end-to-end: React Native mobile app plus React.js and Node.js web backend, covering blog, post 
and event publishing, user management, authentication, in-app purchases, embedded video streaming, and course delivery
• Optimized mobile performance across projects using caching and lazy loading, list virtualization, memoization, and app/bundle size 
reduction; integrated push notifications (FCM/APNs), deep linking, offline storage, and OTA updates
• Defined micro-frontend architecture, reusable component libraries, and coding standards to improve maintainability and scalability 
across projects
• Built Kreuzworträtsel, an internal React Native crossword product, from real-time game logic through iOS and Android store deployment
• Learned Vue.js from scratch to solo-deliver a one-month client validation build (AVORI); the engagement converted and grew into a 4-
person team I went on to lead
• Authored Dockerfiles across multiple frontend repositories to standardize environments and builds across differing project setups
• As the company's first engineer, went on to hire and mentor the engineering org to 12, interview 50+ candidates, and establish its sprint 
and delivery process in ClickUp
• Work fully remote with international clients, collaborating async with documentation-first communication across time zones
React Native Developer Jun 2020 – Jun 2022
Accolite Technologies — Hyderabad, India
• Transitioned from web to mobile engineering, joining the Prudential Bank mobile app team as first React Native project and becoming 
productive on the codebase within weeks
• Built a health assessment feature that captures user photos and submits them to backend services in a standardized format to derive 
BMI and body-fat percentage
• Built the food diet planner and calorie tracker interfaces, expanding the banking app into health and wellness territory
• Built an OCR-based document capture interface, enabling users to scan documents directly in-app instead of manual entry
• Integrated native modules where platform access was required, including SIM/device-level data and deep linking
• Led a full UI/UX optimization pass across the app, modernizing screens and delivering pixel-perfect interfaces from Figma designs
• Audited and removed unused dependencies to reduce app and bundle size, and optimized state management with memoization, selector 
tuning, and list virtualization to eliminate unnecessary re-renders
• Improved app stability and crash-free performance through profiling and performance tuning, contributing to better App Store and Play 
Store ratings
• Mentored a 6-member development team through code reviews, pair programming, and technical training sessions
React.js Developer Jun 2018 – Jun 2020
Pramati Technologies — Hyderabad, India
• Developed and maintained enterprise-grade React.js applications for business clients, owning feature delivery from requirements 
through production
• Built an internal browser-based visitor entry system: captured photos via webcam permissions, combined them with entered details, and 
generated print-ready ID cards, replacing a manual front-desk process
• Worked in a 3-member team to digitize the company's paper-based claims process (previously collected in a physical drop box) into a 
React and Node.js application with multi-level approval workflows
• Built real-time messaging features over WebSockets for a multi-server chat application
• Improved UI load times and perceived performance through code splitting, render optimization, Redis-backed caching, and reusable 
component patterns
• Built responsive, cross-browser interfaces to modern UI/UX standards, collaborating closely with design, backend, and QA teams
Project Engineer Jun 2016 – Jun 2018
Wipro Technologies — Hyderabad, India
• Joined as a .NET engineer and transitioned to React.js and Node.js, contributing to both frontend and backend modules during a large-
scale enterprise modernization effort
• Delivered features across complex enterprise systems, working to quality and scalability requirements set by client stakeholders
SELECTED PROJECTS
LOGIT — Logistics Management Platform (React, Node.js, React Native) — Admin web app for orders, shipments, positions, cargo item 
counts, and invoicing, plus a dedicated driver mobile app for shipment entry and working-hours logging synced to the same backend. 
Technical lead / EM from kickoff.
White-Label Mobile Platform (React Native, Bitrise) — Single React Native codebase producing 4 independently branded client apps, with 
per-brand configuration and automated Bitrise build and store-release pipelines. Sole developer and architect.
DMS — LLM Document Platform (React.js, Node.js, Pinecone) — Document platform where uploads are embedded into Pinecone vector 
storage and queried conversationally through LLM retrieval, with isolated multi-workspace access. Built the chat frontend and led the project.
Content Management Platform (React Native, React.js, Node.js) — Mobile app plus web admin backend for publishing blogs, posts and 
events, with user management, in-app purchases, embedded video streaming, and course delivery. Built both tiers.
Prudential Bank Mobile App (React Native) — Health assessment via photo capture returning BMI and body-fat metrics, food diet planner, 
calorie tracker, and OCR document capture, alongside a full UI/UX and performance optimization pass.
Kreuzworträtsel — Crossword Puzzle App (React Native, TypeScript, NativeWind) — Shipped to both iOS and Android app stores with real-
time game logic, analytics, and full release ownership.  Live: App Store | Google Play
Konica Minolta (Next.js) — Enterprise digital experience built with SSG and ISR for SEO and load-speed gains. Sole developer.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Mobile Development: React Native, Expo, iOS & Android, Cross-Platform Development, NativeWind, Tailwind CSS, React Navigation, Reanimated, 
Gesture Handler, Native Modules & Bridging, Push Notifications (FCM/APNs), Deep Linking & Universal Links, Offline Storage (SQLite, AsyncStorage), 
OTA Updates (CodePush / EAS Update), White-Label Architecture
Mobile Release & Distribution: App Store Connect, TestFlight, Google Play Console, Code Signing & Provisioning Profiles, App Size & Bundle 
Optimization
Frontend Development: React.js, Next.js (SSG/ISR, App Router, Server Components), Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, React Hooks, 
Component Lifecycle, Virtual DOM, Responsive Design, Cross-Browser Compatibility, Micro-Frontend Architecture, Reusable Component Libraries
State Management & Performance: Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Context API, React Query / TanStack Query, SWR, Memoization, Render & Re-render 
Optimization, List Virtualization (FlatList), Caching & Lazy Loading, Web Performance (Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse), Profiling (Flipper, React DevTools)
AI / LLM: LLM-Powered Product Delivery, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Search (Pinecone), Conversational / Chat UI, Prompt 
Engineering, AI-Assisted Development (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code)
Backend & Data: Node.js, REST APIs / RESTful Services, Third-Party API Integration, MongoDB, Redis (caching & indexing), Firebase, WebSockets / 
Real-Time, Authentication (OAuth, JWT, SSO), AWS
DevOps & Tooling: Docker, Bitrise, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Pipelines, Continuous Integration & Deployment, Git, Scalable System Design, Technical 
Documentation
Testing & Quality: Playwright, Unit / Integration / End-to-End Testing, Code Reviews, Quality Assurance
Leadership & Process: Engineering Management, People Management, Hiring, Interviewing & Onboarding, Mentoring & Coaching, Team Building, 
Technical Roadmap & Direction, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Retrospectives, Agile/Scrum, Kanban, ClickUp, Stakeholder Management, Client-
Facing Communication, Technical Pre-Sales, Estimation & Scoping, Remote & Async Collaboration
EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION & KNOWLEDGE SHARING
Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Computer Science — MVSR Engineering College 2012 – 2016
MERN Stack Certification — Wipro Digital, 2017
Monthly internal tech seminars at Omnics on software design principles; technical articles for Pramati's internal engineering blog.
